messages:
alex: Quick sync — planning Q3 roadmap item: quota binding + committed usage (customer asks keep coming). Want to align scope before PM review tomorrow. High-level asks: route-level soft limits, carryover credits, explicit grace windows, ability to bind quota to contracts. Thoughts?
maria: +1. Customers want predictable spend and fewer support tickets when they hit limits. Soft limits with warning + grace sounds highest value.
sam: Agree on soft limits first. Hard limits + penalties later. Big blocker: billing infra needs metering per-route which is not fully shipped.
jin: Billing infra ETA depends on billing-team sprint. If we surface an MVP, we can fake per-route enforcement at proxy layer for a subset of customers.
laura: Product questions — what are success metrics for launch? Number of customers, reduction in support, revenue from committed contracts? Need concrete targets.
alex: Proposed launch criteria: 3 pilot customers signed to committed usage, <5 production support incidents related to quota misconfig per month, and documentation + console UI for binding.
maria: Can we be more specific on committed contract term? 3mo min? 12mo? I'd push for 6mo to make unit economics predictable.
sam: Engineering estimate: MVP soft quotas + grace windows ~2 sprint effort (S), per-route metering + billing integration ~4-6 sprints (M/L).
jin: Risk: caching and KV-store eviction can make enforcement blurry. Need clear behavior doc for prefix caching + grace.
laura: UX scope: console needs a new "Quota bindings" panel, editable per-route and per-tenant. Also API for partners. Mockups will take one sprint.
alex: For MVP scope proposal: 1) Soft quotas with warning (console + email), 2) Grace window (configurable seconds), 3) Simple carryover credits (monthly rollup), 4) Contract metadata on account (manual for pilots). Defer per-route hard enforcement and automated billing adjustments to Q4.
maria: Sounds reasonable. Value note: a couple enterprise prospects already asked for carryover credits and contract-level binding.
sam: Can we ship a short config schema so infra can start? e.g.:
```
{
  "quota_type": "soft",
  "limit": 100000,
  "period": "month",
  "grace_seconds": 86400,
  "carryover": "enabled"
}
```
jin: Schema looks fine. Add field "enforcement": ["warn","block"] to clarify future behavior.
laura: For pilots we'll surface a simple toggle in console and an API: POST /accounts/:id/quota-bindings — ok.
billing-bot: FYI: current billing batch jobs support account-level credits but not per-route. Work item created: BILL-432.
alex: Action items: sam -> prototype proxy-level soft enforcement by EOD next week; laura -> console mockups by Tue; jin -> confirm KV-cache scenarios + doc; maria -> line up pilot customers and contract terms (prefer 6mo); alex -> finalize launch criteria and schedule PM review.
maria: Can we also add SLAs for retries and fallback behavior in the doc? Some customers expect auto-fallback to overage route.
sam: Good call. We'll include fallback policy options: auto-overage-charge vs degrade-to-low-cost-model. That ties into routing rules.
jin: Technical note: fallback needs routing policy updates; will coordinate with runtime team.
laura: I'll put a tiny FAQ in the mockups about how grace and carryover work to reduce support questions.
alex: Ok team — plan to present MVP scope + success metrics at the PM review. If we get buy-in, we'll bump to roadmap. Thanks. :thumbsup:
